display.label: AWS EBS Volume
display.description: Provision Amazon Elastic Block Store (EBS) persistent block storage volumes

globals.label: AWS Region
globals.description: The AWS region where resources will be provisioned.

resource.key_description: Unique name for the EBS volume, applied as the 'Name' tag.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core volume settings including name, availability zone, and size.

fields.label: Volume Name
fields.description: Unique name for the EBS volume, applied as the 'Name' tag and map key.

validation.pattern_error: Volume name must only contain alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores.

fields.label: Availability Zone
fields.description: The Availability Zone in which to launch the EBS volume.

fields.label: Volume Size (GiB)
fields.description: The size of the volume in GiBs.

sections.label: Performance Settings
sections.description: Configure provisioned IOPS and throughput for performance-tuned volumes.

fields.label: Provisioned IOPS
fields.description: Provisioned IOPS. Required for io1/io2, optional for gp3.

fields.label: Throughput (MiB/s)
fields.description: Throughput in MiB/s. Valid only for gp3 volumes (125-1000).

fields.label: Enable Multi-Attach
fields.description: Specifies whether to enable Amazon EBS Multi-Attach (io1/io2 only).

sections.label: Encryption & Snapshots
sections.description: Configure encryption keys and snapshot restoration.

fields.label: Enable Encryption
fields.description: Whether to encrypt the EBS volume.

fields.label: KMS Key ARN
fields.description: Custom KMS master key ARN used to encrypt the volume.

fields.label: Snapshot ID
fields.description: A snapshot ID from which to restore the volume.
